name: repo_bench_dedup_2024
description: A deduplicated repository benchmark constructed from 2024 code repositories to evaluate models' code generation and memorization behavior on de-duplicated code. It measures how well models generalize to unseen code snippets and avoid reproducing memorized content from training corpora. Useful for assessing robustness and true generalization of code LMs after deduplication.
reputation: Relatively new and primarily of interest to researchers studying code memorization and deduplication; limited mainstream adoption so far.
